# Material Symbols (path data only)

The web UI draws its icons with path data copied from Material Symbols Outlined
(weight 400, grade 0, 24 px optical size, `viewBox="0 -960 960 960"`), from
github.com/google/material-design-icons at commit
`49d4db35df873165d6bd6ba09b063c7dafbac2f4`, `symbols/web/<name>/materialsymbolsoutlined/<name>_24px.svg`
(`_fill1_24px.svg` for the filled transport). Licensed under Apache-2.0 (LICENSE).
No font, script or stylesheet of the project is used. docs/13 Icons lists the symbols.
